'''Flexi-paste''' was a type of adhesive.<ref name="DES" /> At one point by [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="10 ABY">[[Elaginn]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the setting of the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', which coincides with that of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series&mdash;dated to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Elaginn]], the leader of the [[Elaginn gang]] of [[spice-jacker]]s, [[Death/Legends|perished]]&mdash;an incident that was later presented as him flexi-pasting himself to a chair and then jumping out of a [[Window/Legends|window]].<ref name="DES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flexi-paste was mentioned in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', [[Michael Allen Horne]]'s [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="DES" />
